❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs), Offline Mode & CLI Guide

Q: Is this an official Google Cloud website or mobile app?

  • No. Both the Web PWA and the Native SwiftUI iOS/iPadOS App are unofficial tools and are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC or Google Cloud.
  • While data is automatically harvested from public Google Cloud feeds, SLA indexes, release notes, and Discovery APIs, it is provided "as-is" without warranty. Always refer to the Official Google Cloud Locations Page, Official Google Cloud SLAs, Official Google Cloud Pricing, and Official Google Cloud Documentation for authoritative information.

Q: How do Offline Mode and the Native SwiftUI iOS/iPadOS App work?

  • Offline-Ready Web PWA: Opening the web app over http://localhost:8080 (or HTTPS) registers sw.js, pre-caching all core views, stylesheets, scripts, and data/mobile_catalog.json so you can browse offline in Airplane Mode.
  • Modern Native SwiftUI App (ios/GoogleCloudExplorer): Built natively for iOS 17+ (iPhone & iPad) with Bento dashboards, a 3D interactive Apple MapKit Globe, Swift Charts SLA/FinOps scrubbers, Customer Stack blueprints, and CoreSpotlight. It embeds mobile_catalog.json directly inside the app bundle for instant 0ms offline launch and delta-syncs via ETag/Gzip against /api/mobile-catalog when online.

Q: How do I run the Web App and CLI locally?

# 1. Start the local web server (serves dist/ + ETag/Gzip REST API + daily auto-refresh thread)
python3 server.py --port 8080

# 2. Query Services, Regions, AI Models, SLAs, Pricing & Release Notes via cli.py:
python3 cli.py service "Vertex AI"
python3 cli.py sla "Cloud Spanner"
python3 cli.py pricing asia-south1
python3 cli.py pricing "BigQuery"
python3 cli.py updates --type FEATURE
python3 cli.py models claude --region us-east5
python3 cli.py compare us-central1 europe-west1 asia-south1 --diff

# 3. Force an immediate live re-harvest & static site rebuild:
python3 cli.py refresh --force
